beats.text: Jatayu, an old vulture and friend of Dasharatha, heard Sita's cries.
'I am sixty thousand years old,' he called, 'but I will not let you take her. Put her down, Ravana!'
Though weak with age, he attacked Ravana with all his strength.
He smashed the chariot and fought the demon king with beak and talons.
But Ravana overpowered the brave old bird, and Jatayu fell.
As Ravana flew on, Sita dropped her jewels, wrapped in her scarf, onto a mountain where five monkeys sat.
Later, Rama and Lakshmana found the dying bird. He lived long enough to tell Rama everything.
'Ravana took her south,' he whispered, and breathed his last in Rama's arms.
Rama performed his funeral like a son, and wept for him as he had for his father.
